general.language_hint: Explicitly override CRABS display language or sync automatically with the game.
general.check_updates_hint: Periodically check for CRABS updates, and notify me.
general.perf_mode_hint: Applies performance optimizations to the base game.
general.banner_hint: Display info banner on room join.
general.privacy_full_hint: If enabled, the Privacy Mode hotkey blanks the entire screen instead of just the left side.
general.halo_hint: Show a pulsing halo effect on character avatars when you mouse over them in the roster or chat.
general.edit_keybinds_hint: Open the game's Keybindings menu to change the Privacy Mode and Drawer hotkeys.

drawer.enable_hint: Enable the sliding drawer interface on the edge of the screen.
drawer.tab_hint: Display the CRABS drawer tab on the edge of the screen.
drawer.animated_logo_hint: Use the animated logo when performance is optimal.
drawer.close_whisper_hint: Close drawer after sending a whisper+ message.
drawer.close_chat_hint: Close drawer after sending a message.
drawer.focus_hover_hint: When you mouse over a player's card, change the page they are on.
drawer.auto_scroll_hint: Automatically scroll the drawer roster to the character matching the avatar your mouse is over.

maps.compass_hint: Show a directional arrow on map.

chat.mentions_hint: Highlights chat messages containing your name or nickname.
chat.notifications_hint: Get an OS alert when mentioned (only triggers if the game is tabbed out or minimized).
chat.caps_hint: Forces the first letter of your name(s) to be capitalized when highlighted.
chat.color_match_hint: Colors your name in highlighted messages to match your character's actual label color.
chat.custom_words_hint: Comma-separated list of extra words to trigger highlights.
chat.ignore_phrases_hint: One phrase per line. Use * as a wildcard (e.g., 'pick* a rose').
chat.highlight_color_hint: Pick a custom color for chat highlights.
chat.auto_beep_hint: Attempt to send Whisper+ as a beep if a friend leaves the room before you hit send.
chat.whisper_plus_always_on_hint: Automatically upgrades standard /whisper commands and quick replies to Whisper+.
chat.auto_beep_regular_whisper_hint: Allows standard /whisper commands to automatically send as an account beep if a friend leaves the room.
chat.hover_links_hint: Mousing over names in the chat log triggers the roster focus halo and map compass.
chat.normalize_font_hint: Temporarily converts fancy/styled Unicode fonts in chat messages to standard text while hovering over them.

config.local_only_hint: If checked, settings are only saved to this browser and will not sync across your devices.
config.cloud_hint: Shows how much server allowance is used. Exceeding this will truncate new items from the server sync.
config.delete_server_hint: Wipes your CRABS settings from the game server.
config.export_hint: Copy your settings string to share or backup.
config.import_hint: Paste a settings string to overwrite current config.

notifications.cloud_both_limit: Cloud Sync: Dropped invalid long strings AND reached 8KB storage limit. Excess kept local.
notifications.cloud_capacity_limit: Cloud Sync capacity reached (8KB). Excess words/phrases kept local only.
notifications.cloud_invalid_items: Cloud Sync: Dropped individual words/phrases that exceeded character limits. Kept local.
notifications.export_failed: Failed to copy config to clipboard.
notifications.import_prompt: Paste your CRABS settings string here:
notifications.import_invalid: Import failed. Invalid or corrupted string.
